summary: Brady Corp (BRC) signed a definitive equity purchase agreement to acquire Honeywell International’s Productivity Solutions & Services business for $1.4 billion in cash. The transaction is expected to close in H2 2026. Financing will come from new debt and cash on hand; BMO Capital Markets committed up to $1.8 billion in bridge facilities (Tranche A $1B, Tranche B $800M). The acquisition is not financing-conditioned. Regulatory clearance under HSR is required. A pre-closing internal reorganization by the seller is a condition. Watch for antitrust review timing and integration risk; the all-cash deal reduces execution uncertainty.
